name: Azuke Finance
description: Azuke Finance — a landing-page theme for invoice funding aimed at small suppliers. A pale page with a tight Onest headline and one coral word above a bowed, monochrome documentary photo mosaic that bleeds off the right edge; a full-bleed photograph with a flush-left dark overlay box telling the cash gap; a sticky sage panel beside three scrolling chapters with giant figures and touching thumbnails; one full-width fee table with a worked example; story cards; questions; and a single application band. A fixed dark vertical Apply tab repeats the one call to action. Onest for headlines, Inter Tight for reading. Thirteen English pages (home, how it works, pricing, who it's for, stories, about, FAQ, apply, contact, early access, privacy, terms, thanks); four more languages follow.

fonts.role: display: headlines, figures, wordmark (variable, Latin subset)
text: body, labels, navigation (variable, Latin subset)

summary.en: Invoice funding for small suppliers: tight headline over a bowed documentary photo mosaic, a sticky chapter panel with giant figures and a fixed Apply tab.
